Native both-hand lift and overhead release, absent from rest pose; gameplay remains unchanged.

next_action.action: Optional artistic review of the installed creature and linked viewer; no production step is pending.

acceptance.agent_visual: complete: eight normal/half-speed sampled playback sequences, dedicated head/hand detail, native indoor/outdoor three-tier LOD comparisons and combat reviewed.

service_docs.route: meshy-t2 Smart Topology mesh-only, 15000 target triangles, 5 credits; preserve selected A-pose.

corrections.finding: Confirmed incorrect two-eye head geometry and broken facial boundaries, despite correct single-eye image. Hands need digit count inspection.
corrections.action: Reject v1; same primary reference with current meshy-t2.5 topology route (official docs checked), inspect before any rig.

corrections.finding: Body candidate has improved separated digits; head remains malformed with collapsed eye/mouth, turned relative to torso and broken eyebrow/hair edges.
corrections.action: Preserve body candidate; dedicated multi-view head geometry and PBR from selected head references, following problem-head route. Inspect projection versus graft after return.

corrections.finding: Dedicated head has correct one-eye identity, but service remesh has 1052 boundary edges and 1048 nonmanifold edges after coincident-vertex welding. Direct reduction of dense source preserves excessive subpixel hair perforations and collapses facial features.
corrections.action: Reject remesh and direct-decimation recovery. Voxel cleanup of original dense head at 0.008 source units before local silhouette reduction; inspect face and neck before rigging.

corrections.finding: Closed voxel surface preserves the one-eye silhouette, but 6500-triangle reductions soften lips/eye detail; local projection restores some form but leaves five triangulation conflicts. This candidate is not selected.
corrections.action: Dedicated Smart Topology head from the full-resolution front close-up, 10000 triangles / 5 credits, within the existing 100-credit limit; compare before rigging.

selected_geometry.inspection: Front, profile, back and three-quarter clay checked. One central eye, native clothes, repaired round discs, boot hole, crown and eyebrow; old head/hair removed. Neck welded; only covered lower-body waist boundary remains.

hand_repair.reason: Generated Smart body had a sixth folded digit on the back of each palm
hand_repair.weight_transfer: Existing vertices exact; only two cap centres interpolated, maximum source distance 18.87 mm

rig.frame_method: source-frame Mixamo rig, exact mapped Meshy skin, fitted rings, five fingers and four twist bones

fixed_since: boot sole geometry and grounded stance
